lcc_original: 永恆主就後悔造了人在地上，心中憂傷。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of יהוה (WH03068), attached normally as explicit word
了 is a Chinese perfective aspect particle with no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated between 造 and {<WAH0853>}人
Both implicit markers {<WAH03588>} (כִּי) and {<WAH0853>} (אֵת) remain implicit — LCC has no explicit words for them either
